strategy.name: nasdaq100_point_in_time_p24_original_difference_strict_equal_weight
strategy.description: 在2005至2012年的历史时点Nasdaq-100成分中，对每只证券独立计算原P24与严格P24。原P24要求价格高于SMA180、SMA180最近10日平均每日涨幅严格高于0.02%、SMA20最近10个完成值的OLS对数日斜率乘R²再乘100严格高于0，并连续2个完成交易日合格；严格P24只把两个门槛提高为0.04%和0.05%，其余完全不变。比较三条不排名、无数量上限的每日等权组合：全部原P24状态、原P24但不属于严格状态的差集、全部严格P24状态。历史成员身份延迟一个XNYS交易日使用；普通信号在完成Close确认并于下一Open成交。候选历史成分与行情仍为pending_review，所以结果只作探索性证据。
strategy.buy_rule: 每天完成Close后，在滞后一交易日已知的Nasdaq-100历史成员中检查每只股票的P24目标状态。原P24组合持有所有原状态为真的股票；差集组合只持有原状态为真且严格状态为假的股票；严格组合持有所有严格状态为真的股票。每只股票第一次进入任一P24状态都必须由对应三个条件连续2个完成交易日成立；没有排名、Top-N或主观筛选。
strategy.sell_rule: 只要股票在该组合对应的目标状态变为假，或不再属于滞后时点成员集合，就在下一可执行Open退出。原P24与严格P24仍沿用任一条件单日不成立便取消目标状态；差集还会在股票升级为严格状态时卖出，因为它已不再属于差集。没有固定百分比止损或盘中退出。
strategy.signal_time: SMA、长期平均涨幅、短期趋势质量和连续日确认只使用拆股及股息调整后的当日完成Close及更早价格；成员身份统一延迟一个XNYS交易日，分析窗口开始时不继承此前连续日计数或仓位。
strategy.execution_time: 每个Close产生下一交易日Open的完整目标名单。执行时先卖出或减持，再买入或加仓；每次都按信号Close账户净值和信号Close价格把全部合格股恢复为等权。每边分别测试0或10bps不利成交价冲击。
strategy.positioning: 三条组合各自从10万美元现金开始，long-only，持有所有合格股并每日恢复等权；允许小数股，不融资、不做空，现金不计息，无合格股时全部现金。

plain_language.summary: 把P24直接用于当时真实存在的纳指成分，比较原门槛、严格门槛以及两者差集各自能否形成有效的全体等权选股组合。
plain_language.buy: 每天从当时已知的纳指成分中，买入所有连续两天满足对应P24条件的股票；不排名，也不限制数量。
plain_language.sell: 股票不再满足对应P24状态或退出历史成分集合，就在下一开盘卖出；差集里的股票变成严格状态时也会离开差集。
plain_language.execution: 收盘后确认名单，下一开盘先卖后买，并把当期所有合格股票恢复为等权。
plain_language.position: 三个组合各用独立的10万美元账户，合格股票全部持有，无标的时持有现金，不融资、不做空。

selection.allocation: restore equal weight at every completed Close for next Open

parameters.initial_state: all portfolios start in cash; indicator history may prewarm but confirmation streak resets at analysis_start
parameters.temporary_unavailability_policy: a requested change with no real signal Close or next execution Open is frozen until a later daily decision with real bars; no buy uses a synthetic carry bar
parameters.terminal_price_policy: after the final vendor bar an existing holding may be settled once at the carried final adjusted price on a later scheduled Open; no new positive target may use a terminal proxy

holding_diagnostics.holding_sessions: sessions with at least one positive position after that Open's execution
holding_diagnostics.holding_cagr_pct: full account terminal growth annualized over holding_sessions/252; includes costs but compresses cash-only sessions and is diagnostic rather than a selection metric
holding_diagnostics.holdings_count: number of positive security positions after daily Open execution

benchmark: QQQ Buy & Hold over 2005-01-03 through 2012-12-31 at the same initial cash and per-side cost; the three strategy portfolios are the primary comparison.

reporting.reuse_review: Use the shared v5 renderer with human-language flow first; display three equity/drawdown paths, QQQ benchmark, holdings counts, exposure, holding sessions and holding CAGR; keep exact P24 formulas and data caveats in the folded appendix.

research.hypothesis: P24 may be more useful as a per-stock eligibility state than as a full-position QQQ timing rule. Partitioning original P24 into the strict subset and its exact difference can show whether the stricter state captures higher-quality holdings or merely discards useful but less mature uptrends.
research.primary_metric: At 10bps compare calendar CAGR, maximum drawdown, Sharpe, annual volatility, turnover, exposure, holding sessions, holding CAGR and holdings-count distribution for all three portfolios; use 0bps only to attribute friction and compare with QQQ Buy & Hold.
research.selection_rule: Run and display all three predeclared portfolios. Do not choose or promote a winner from 2005-2012, do not add ranking, Top-N, sector caps or parameter changes after seeing results, and do not use holding CAGR as a replacement for calendar CAGR.
research.validation_plan: Unit-test strict-subset identity, exact original=strict union difference partition, two-session confirmation, all-qualifier selection, next-Open equal weighting and order replay. Reconcile every portfolio's immutable order plan against PyBroker within 1e-6, then run report tests, real Chrome interaction, PDF gates, catalog checks, workspace audit and validate_run.
research.promotion_criteria: No path can be promoted while the Nasdaq-100 package is pending_review. A later approved-data test would require coherent improvement in drawdown-adjusted performance at 10bps, reasonable turnover, nontrivial holdings breadth and a separately frozen out-of-sample window or cross-market procedure.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any current-constituent lookback, unlagged membership, inherited pre-window confirmation, same-Close execution, ranking or hidden cap, omission of qualifiers, synthetic-bar buys, financing, failure of strict subset partition, ledger mismatch, use of 2005-2012 to retune P24, or presentation of candidate data as approved evidence.
